exposure: intra-caesarean post placental intrauterine contraceptive device (PPIUCD) insertion
cohort: 332 women who underwent postpartum insertion of IUCD at a tertiary care hospital in Aurangabad, India, from November 2019 to October 2021.
finding: Intra-caesarean PPIUCD insertion was found safe with low expulsion rates (3.91%), minimal bleeding, negligible infection rates, and high continuation rates (95.05%) at 6 months follow-up.
